SELECT '出库' AS flow_type, 'OUT' AS direction, o.outbound_no AS bill_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(w.erp_stock_code, ''), w.warehouse_code) AS warehouse_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.kingdee_code, ''), m.material_code) AS material_code, m.material_name AS material_name, COALESCE(d.batch_no, '') AS batch_no, a.actual_qty AS qty, o.update_time AS biz_time FROM wms_outbound_order o JOIN wms_outbound_detail d ON d.outbound_id = o.id JOIN wms_outbound_allocation a ON a.detail_id = d.id JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = a.location_id JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = l.warehouse_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = d.material_id WHERE o.status = '已完成'
AND a.actual_qty > 0 AND o.update_time BETWEEN #{windowStart} AND #{windowEnd}
